summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend e2e testing of Attouna Service. 24/24 backend pytest cases passed. Frontend home/jobs/admin auth/redirect/application submission all work. Two frontend issues found: (1) sector-apply-{sector} buttons on JobsPage do NOT pre-fill the sector field in ApplicationDialog, and (2) a ResizeObserver runtime error overlay appears when opening admin job sector Select dropdown — the overlay blocks UI clicks until dismissed.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking sector-apply-{sector} button opens dialog but does NOT pre-fill the sector trigger (shows 'Choisir un secteur'). User must manually re-pick sector. defaultSector prop not flowing through.

Opening the 'Secteur' Select inside admin-job-dialog triggers a 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' uncaught runtime overlay (react-error-overlay) that blocks clicks until manually closed. Affects admin UX for create/edit job. Likely from shadcn/radix Select interaction.

missing_testids.issue: SelectItem children inside admin-job-sector lack data-testid (only the public ApplicationDialog has sector-option-{key}). Minor — testers can click by text.

action_items: Pass defaultSector through to ApplicationDialog so that sector-apply-{sector} pre-selects the sector (check JobsPage ApplicationDialog usage and sector state init in dialog).

Suppress the ResizeObserver loop error overlay (e.g., via CRA ignored errors / window.addEventListener('error') filter, or upgrade radix-ui Select / wrap dropdown in try/catch). This shouldn't block clicks in preview/prod.
Optional: add data-testid='admin-sector-option-{key}' to admin job dialog Select options for testability.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/auth/me does not raise 401 explicitly when payload lacks expected role/type before token decode validation — currently fine because role/type are checked post-decode.
/api/applications stores cv_base64 in MongoDB (10MB cap enforced). Document size remains bounded — OK.
All endpoints correctly project out _id; verified no _id leaks in any response body.
Admin password is reset on every backend restart if env mismatches DB hash — idempotent seeding works as designed.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed jobs (3, one per sector) and one TEST_ application; all are deleted in TestZCleanup at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_attouna_api.py is the regression suite — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_attouna_api.py -v`. It is self-cleaning. Two frontend bugs remain: (1) sector pre-fill via sector-apply-{sector} broken, (2) ResizeObserver overlay on admin Select dropdown. Re-test these specifically after main agent fixes. Application submission flow on /offres works end-to-end (verified screenshot 'Candidature envoyée!'). Admin login + tab navigation + add-job dialog open all work; admin job creation could not be completed via UI due to bug #2.

rca of the issue.bug1_sector_not_prefilled: JobsPage passes defaultSector to ApplicationDialog when clicking sector-apply-{sector}, but the dialog component likely does not derive its initial 'sector' state from props or does not reset it via useEffect when defaultSector changes. Inspect ApplicationDialog.jsx for the sector state initializer and add a useEffect to sync state with the defaultSector prop on prop change.
rca of the issue.bug2_resize_observer_overlay: Radix UI Select inside Dialog can trigger ResizeObserver loop warnings (well-known issue). In CRA dev mode, react-error-overlay catches them and renders a fullscreen overlay that intercepts clicks. Mitigation: in src/index.js add `window.addEventListener('error', e => { if (e.message?.includes('ResizeObserver')) e.stopImmediatePropagation(); });` or upgrade @radix-ui/react-select.
